title: collect
description: EXECUTES CODE of a registered repository through its registered adapter and the qex queue. Starts a durable job and returns its id; the same requestId with identical parameters returns the existing job, other parameters are CONFLICT. Takes exact example ids, never argv or shell text. Next: collection_status, then view_result.

repo.description: Repository id registered with `paneweft repo add`.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous reply of the same query.

maxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte budget of the whole serialized reply (design section 4).
